summary: Regression test of the Company Interim tab refactor (monolithic 673-line CompanyInterimTab.js split into MissionCard, TimesheetCard, CreateMissionDialog, CompleteMissionDialog, RejectTimesheetDialog, RateProviderDialog, DeleteMissionDialog, OverquotaDialog under /app/frontend/src/components/interim/). Frontend-only testing per request. Login as +224620200001 / BoutiqueDemo2026!, Interim tab loaded showing 4 existing missions + 1 timesheet. End-to-end Create Mission flow executed successfully (filled title/jobtype/region cascade/city cascade/commune cascade/quartier/rate/description and submitted). New mission count went 4→5, confirming the orchestrator submitForm() + CreateMissionDialog wiring is intact. All required data-testids verified present on the live page. No console pageerrors observed.

integration_issues.issue: delete-mission-{id} button opens DeleteMissionDialog correctly but the confirm button text/selector inside the AlertDialog was not located by Playwright (`button:has-text("Supprimer")` matched 0 inside the alertdialog). Test could not complete the destructive confirm. Likely AlertDialog uses an AlertDialogAction with a localized label different from 'Supprimer'/'Confirmer' OR is wrapped in a non-button element. Worth a quick code check — orchestrator side (deleteMission()) is fine; only the modal's confirm button selector needs verification. Note: the new TEST mission therefore was NOT cleaned up (still present in DB as TEST_regression_refactor).
affected_selectors: [data-testid for DeleteMissionDialog confirm button - none currently

integration_issues.issue: On the existing 'Plombier pour installation sanitaire complète' card flagged 'Terminée' with 1/1 retenu(s), expanding the candidates accordion did NOT reveal any `rate-prov-{id}` nor `invoice-{id}` buttons (0 matches). Either (a) the accepted candidate row is not rendering the conditional block `a.status==='accepted' && mission.status==='completed'`, (b) the timesheet/data is in an unexpected state, or (c) accordion expansion targeted the wrong card after the page re-rendered post create-mission. Recommend the main agent log in manually as the company, open the Plombier mission's Candidats accordion, and verify the ⭐ Noter + Facture buttons appear next to Mamadou Diallo (provider_id of the accepted candidate). If they don't, this is a real regression of MissionCard.js conditional rendering.

Manually verify on Plombier 'Terminée' mission that `rate-prov-{appId}` and `invoice-{appId}` buttons render for the accepted candidate; if missing, inspect MissionCard.js lines 99-114 conditional `a.status === 'accepted' && mission.status === 'completed'`.
Cleanup: delete the leftover TEST_regression_refactor mission created by this test run (or it will accumulate on every regression).

Run remaining flows manually since they were not automated this run: (1) Customer Interim tab via /customer/auth → 'Intérim' (the 2-mission quota toast on 3rd create), (2) Provider 'Particulier' (blue) vs 'Entreprise' (gray) badge on /auth → ProviderInterimTab, (3) OverquotaDialog when accepting a 2nd candidate on the 1-place 'Électricien câblage' mission, (4) RejectTimesheetDialog 5-char motif validation (requires a fresh submitted timesheet — current one is already rejected), (5) RateProviderDialog full submission (5★ + comment). All have preserved data-testids per the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: CompanyInterimTab.js (330 lines) is clean post-refactor. Routes object pattern + tokenKey prop is the correct way to share with CustomerInterimTab.js — DRY without coupling. Good.

MissionCard.js: the dual toggle buttons (line 43-46 'Actions terminales' for completed missions + line 58-60 generic 'Candidats') share the same onToggleExpand(mission.id) so they wire the same state — could be confusing but functionally correct. Consider a single conditional label for cleaner UX.

CreateMissionDialog.js: Select cascades (region→city→commune) correctly reset child values when parent changes (line 42, 56). Cascade tested live with 8 regions → 1 city for Conakry → 13 communes. Good.
DeleteMissionDialog confirm button needs a data-testid for automation parity with the other dialogs (which all have one). Minor.
Customer wrapper (CustomerInterimTab.js, 30 lines) is exemplary — pure prop passing, no duplicated logic. Good refactor.

The phone login input has no `type='tel'` attribute — first <input> of /company/auth is the phone field, second is the password. CustomerInterimTab.js is a thin wrapper passing CUSTOMER_ROUTES + tokenKey='customerToken' to the same orchestrator, so most of the company-side validation transfers — only the customer-specific quota (max 2 active missions) needs separate verification.
rca of the issue: (1) Delete confirm button not located → DeleteMissionDialog.js inside MissionConfirmDialogs.js likely renders an AlertDialogAction without a data-testid AND with a label that doesn't match 'Supprimer'/'Confirmer' (could be 'Oui, supprimer' or similar). Cheap fix: add data-testid='confirm-delete-mission-btn' to that button. (2) Plombier rate-prov/invoice buttons missing on expand → either the accepted candidate's status field in the DB is not exactly the string 'accepted', OR mission.status is not exactly 'completed' (e.g. 'terminée' label vs 'completed' code), OR the accordion expansion races with mission re-fetch. Needs manual eyeball check by main agent.
